_doc_v791: v7.9.1 truth note (values below are unchanged): compile_and_verify.py has no `studio` tier (its --tier choices are auto | fast | full). The studio tier's own cli_flags compile with `--tier full`, and a raw-video probe recommends `full`, so on the studio path the bgm_lra_offset_optimizer (16 kHz BGM steady-state offset selector) and the R35 post-AAC true-peak guard DO run; tiers.studio.skipped_heavy_gates only describes probe_and_align --tier studio, not the compile. Only `--tier fast` skips both at compile time (`--no-optimize-bgm-offset` skips the BGM optimizer alone).

projected_facesafe_r26_r208.rationale: Haar eye [0.10..0.90, 0.30..0.50] and mouth [0.25..0.75, 0.70..0.90] envelopes protect facial expressiveness while exempting brief <1.5s opening hook stomps.

broll_45_token_hygiene_and_v8.rationale: Blocks 45 prompt tokens known to trigger AI text/chart/logo/checklist hallucinations and catches frozen or blank B-roll renders.

bgm_lra_and_short_term_ducking.source: EBU Tech 3342 + Spec 1.1.1 S29/L12 (4-track x 40-60s benchmark: LRA <= 5.0 LU, voice - bed >= 10 LU)
bgm_lra_and_short_term_ducking.rationale: Selecting a stable BGM offset prevents intro/drop volume swings from masking speech intelligibility on phone speakers.
